name: Barter
description: Show what an NPC has for sale.
guided_description: Open the NPC's shop. Only merchants, smiths, innkeepers and other traders, when the player wants to buy or sell. Prices are fixed; never promise discounts.

source.description: The NPC to open their barter menu.

prompt: To show the player what you have for sale, begin your response with '{key}:'.
